places.name: Boon Tong Kee Balestier

what.en: Chilli crab and black pepper crab with fried mantou buns, at the seafood centre on the beach

what.en: North and South Indian food on banana leaves, known for fish head curry, with tandoori chicken and naan

why.th: ติดแอร์ ที่นั่งเยอะ มีนานกับไก่ย่างและโยเกิร์ตที่ไม่เผ็ดให้เด็ก

what.en: A dim sum house dating from 1962, with molten salted egg buns, xiaolongbao and mee sua

what.en: A Victorian cast-iron market hall with food of every kind; at night the street beside it becomes satay street

what.en: An air-conditioned food court in the Marina Bay Sands mall, with well-known hawker names, chicken rice, laksa and noodles

what.en: A food court styled as an old village on level 3 of VivoCity, with chicken rice, noodles and desserts
